title: Zypper Review (2026)
intro: Zypper is evaluated here as Marketing & Growth software — Zypper is an influencer marketing platform — creator discovery, campaign management, and reporting for brands and agencies. Tiered/quote pricing (2026-08-19 — confirm on zypper.com/pricing). This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s marketing methodology (ease of use, campaign/content tools, marketing automation, funnel/conversion, analytics, brand monitoring, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Zypper when influencer campaigns are the marketing job.
